CORRECTION of the floor ce08ffafdff wrote. That commit banked 93 and in doing so RAISED the floor from the 92 that ea037c94dce had just committed, because the 93 was measured in a detached worktree created before that commit was pulled -- so it saw neither the account_fleet fix nor its bank. The measurement was stale, not the tree. True count at HEAD, re-measured twice in a worktree created after the pull with both fixes present: 91. The two units between 93 and 91 are real paid-down debt that the stale number was papering over -- one is ea037c94dce (account_fleet._compute_move_ids), one is ce08ffafdff (account.account._compute_display_name). Measure the ratchet at the HEAD you are committing onto, after the pull; a worktree is only as fresh as the moment it was created.

Three stock.picking fields declared the uid they read: 94 -> 91.

`picking_warning_text`, `show_lots_text` and `show_allocation` each resolve
`self.env.user.has_group(...)` on a non-stored field, so the transaction held one
cache entry for every reader and the first one answered for all of them. Measured
on one picking, one transaction, two users, the privileged one reading first:

  priv_first   -> [(priv, "SECRET\n"), (plain, "SECRET\n")]
  plain_first  -> [(plain, ""),        (priv, "")]

`picking_warning_text` is gated on stock.group_warning_stock and carries the
partner`s internal instructions, so the first line is a user outside the group
reading them and the second is the entitled user seeing nothing. Regression test:
stock/tests/test_picking_location_rules.py::TestPickingUserDependentFields.
